description: This PHP source file defines the class Vtiger_PDF_TCPDF, which extends the TCPDF class to handle PDF generation with custom font and text height calculations for the vtiger CRM platform.

classes.name: Vtiger_PDF_TCPDF
classes.description: A subclass of TCPDF tailored for vtiger CRM, adding methods for font handling and string height calculation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PDF object with default font settings.

methods.name: getFontSize
methods.description: Returns the current font size in points.

methods.name: setFontFamily
methods.description: Sets the font family for the PDF document.

methods.name: GetStringHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of a given string considering line wrapping within a specified width.

methods.name: SetFont
methods.description: Sets the font for the PDF, selecting from available fonts and sizes.
